slides.title: Why I sell them unpolished
slides.sub: And why the choice stays with you.

slides.title: A heavy polish can't be undone.
slides.body: The edges the maker cut are gone for good.

slides.title: What heavy polishing does
slides.body: A wheel takes metal off. Sharp bevels go soft, lugs get thinner, brushed and polished surfaces blur together.

slides.title: Why original matters
slides.body: Collectors look for original case lines first. Once they're gone, no one can put them back.

slides.title: So I leave them as they came
slides.body: Worn or nearly untouched, every scratch in the description. You see exactly what you get.

slides.title: Want some shine back?
slides.body: I offer a light polish for hairline scratches. It takes off as little as possible and keeps the case lines sharp.

slides.title: Your call, not mine
slides.body: Keep it original, or ask for the light polish before it ships or any time later.

slides.title: Serviced inside
slides.body: Every movement is serviced before it's listed. 6-month warranty on the service.

slides.title: Unpolished means
items: light polish on request, never a heavy one
